sampling_rule: Census of every datasets/<name> directory containing clean.csv and dirty.csv at pinned commit, with all failures and zeroes retained; no dataset selection by difference outcomes. Default benchmark, scale extension and toy reported separately.
proposed_primary_endpoints: CSV schema/header/dimension concordance, duplicate headers and unsupported rows; label denominator validity before arithmetic.
Per-pair exact raw-string difference label set versus one-pass official normalizer label set; removed/added label counts and Jaccard, full counts incl zero.
Per-pair number of existing dirty and clean values failing official normalizer idempotence; label-set and target-value drift after one load-export-reload. No artificial value injection.
proposed_secondary_endpoints: Native scorer on the same official-error cell coordinates: raw-clean values versus once-normalized clean values; scores are deterministic adapter probes, not repair algorithms or evidence of published-score errors.
Raw-diff adapter dictionary versus normalized-diff adapter dictionary under official scorer; separate changed prediction cell set from changed replacement values.
Stable key validation only where upstream explicitly declares a key. No inferred ID earns authoritative status; no row permutation counted as naturally occurring error.
failure_policy: No outcome-driven source substitution; all zero endpoints report as negative evidence. Invalid shape/schema is reported and excluded only from arithmetic endpoints requiring alignment, while remaining in census denominator.
source_truth_limit: Existing author-provided clean files are benchmark reference truth, not independent business truth. Hospital errors are randomly imposed and tax is synthetic per Baran paper; do not describe all seven as natural errors.
license_access: Root repository Apache-2.0; separate per-dataset rights chain not evidenced by inspected files. Local-only read/restoration permitted under task; do not redistribute third-party CSV/source. Deliver original audit code, aggregate evidence, pinned URLs, SHA-256/Git blob hashes and restore steps.
no_upstream_execution_until: Root freezes protocol and confirms source inspection/allowed runtime plan. dataset.py imports only re,sys,html,pandas; load that module directly without importing package __init__/benchmark/detectors.
